firstPlayerRule: Use the rulebook's joke criterion—most recently abducted by the CIA or KGB—or choose the starter randomly. Continue clockwise.
officialTieBreak: Random selection is an explicitly permitted alternative in the rulebook.
clarifications: Place the Character deck in front of the first active player. After each turn, pass it to the player on the left, who becomes the next active player.
